# reco_users (Data Source)

Lists all Reco users. Use this data source to reference user_id values in reco_user resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reco_users" "all" {}

output "admin_emails" {
  value = [for u in data.reco_users.all.users : u.email_address if contains(u.user_roles, "Admin")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) List of users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `auth_methods` (List of String) Active authentication methods.
- `creation_time` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `email_address` (String) Email address.
- `enablement_status` (String) Enablement status.
- `is_bypass_sso_enforcement` (Boolean) SSO bypass flag.
- `last_login_time` (String) Last login timestamp.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `segments` (List of String) Assigned segments.
- `user_id` (String) Stable Reco user ID.
- `user_roles` (List of String) Assigned roles.
